title: Knowledge Entry Write V1 (the answer to a create or a revision)
$comment: DL-KB-02. POST /api/knowledge-entries and POST /api/knowledge-entries/{id}/revisions answer with this envelope, whose `entry` member is the revision document exactly as it was stored -- the same object GET .../{id} returns inside `current`, not a re-built copy. `stored: true` is a statement about this request only: the bytes are in the state database and readable through the read route. It is not a statement that the source was checked (source.verification stays UNVERIFIED) and not a statement that the entry was reviewed. The envelope exists so the write answer has a version of its own instead of borrowing the entry document's.
